name: alert
title: Alert
description: Inline, in-flow status block. Persistent (not dismissed automatically), tied to a region of the page (not the whole app), and never floating. Four tones — info, success, warning, danger. Optional dismiss control + optional inline action. Distinct from Toast (transient, page-level, floating), Banner (page-level non-dismissible system state), and ValidationMessage (single-field form error).
